text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of an investigation into installing speed humps on Clearview Heights, between Trethewey Drive (east intersection) and Trethewey Drive (west intersection). The results indicate that the criteria to justify installing speed humps are not satisfied.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on January 8, 2020.
